rip_frontier_clear_batch_effect = {
	every_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = rip_frontier_batch_step_@ROOT } clr_province_flag = rip_frontier_batch_step_@ROOT }
	clr_country_flag = rip_frontier_batch_started
}

rip_frontier_crimea_one_effect = {
	random_province = {
	 limit = { rip_frontier_crimea_target = yes }
	 add_claim = ROOT
	 set_province_flag = rip_frontier_batch_step_@ROOT
	 ROOT = { set_country_flag = rip_frontier_batch_started change_variable = { which = rip_frontier_claims_issued value = 1 } }
	}
}

rip_frontier_crimea_purchase_effect = {
	if = {
	 limit = { rip_frontier_crimea_can_buy = yes }
	 rip_frontier_clear_batch_effect = yes
	 add_treasury = -100
	 change_variable = { which = rip_frontier_ducats_spent value = 100 }
	 add_dip_power = -50
	change_variable = { which = rip_frontier_dip_spent value = 50 }
	 set_country_flag = rip_frontier_expedition_recent
	 set_country_flag = rip_frontier_crimea_purchased
	 change_variable = { which = rip_frontier_batches value = 1 }
	 rip_frontier_crimea_one_effect = yes
	 rip_frontier_crimea_one_effect = yes
	 rip_frontier_crimea_one_effect = yes
	 rip_frontier_crimea_one_effect = yes
	 rip_frontier_crimea_one_effect = yes
	 rip_frontier_clear_batch_effect = yes
	 if = {
	  limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = ruthenian_eastward_policy } }
	  set_country_flag = ruthenian_eastward_policy
	  set_country_flag = rip_frontier_crimea_benefit_started
	  add_country_modifier = { name = ruthenian_eastward_mandate duration = 7300 }
	  country_event = { id = ruthenian_eastward.1 }
	 }
	}
}

rip_frontier_expedition_upkeep_effect = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { rip_frontier_crimea_base = yes } }
	remove_country_modifier = ruthenian_eastward_mandate
	remove_country_modifier = ruthenian_frontier_organizers
	remove_country_modifier = ruthenian_raiding_columns
	remove_country_modifier = ruthenian_frontier_patrol_licenses
	remove_country_modifier = ruthenian_steppe_trade_licenses
	every_owned_province = { remove_province_modifier = steppe_border_defense remove_province_modifier = zasechnaya_cherta_province }
	}
	if = { limit = { NOT = { rip_frontier_ural_base = yes } }
	remove_country_modifier = ruthenian_ural_gate
	remove_country_modifier = ruthenian_ural_fortified_line
	remove_country_modifier = ruthenian_ural_trade_posts
	}
	if = { limit = { NOT = { rip_frontier_manchuria_base = yes } }
	remove_country_modifier = ruthenian_manchurian_push
	remove_country_modifier = ruthenian_manchurian_wardens
	remove_country_modifier = ruthenian_manchurian_companies
	}
}
